decision_table.name: Determine_GA_Filing_Requirement
decision_table.description: Determine if corporation must file Georgia state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

condition.name: has_physical_presence
condition.comment: Has physical presence in GA (office, employees, property)

actions.action: // Physical nexus established - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
Georgia filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in state).
Reference: GA Department of Revenue Publication Reference: GA Code § 48-7-21 (Corporate Income Tax) Reference: GA Code § 48-7-31 (Filing Requirements)

actions.action: // Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
Georgia filing required due to economic nexus (post-Wayfair). Threshold: $100,000 gross receipts OR 200 transactions.
Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018) Reference: GA Department of Revenue Economic Nexus Guidance Reference: GA Code § 48-8-2(8)(K) (Economic Nexus)
No Georgia nexus - no filing requirement. Any estimated payments would be refunded.

decision_table.name: Calculate_GA_Income_Adjustments
decision_table.description: Calculate Georgia state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments

rule.policy:
Georgia state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income.
Additions include: - Interest on U.S. government obligations - IRC Section 199A deduction addback - State income taxes deducted federally
Subtractions include: - Interest on Georgia state and local bonds - Georgia NOL deduction (separate from federal NOL)
Reference: GA Form 600 Instructions (Schedule 1 - Adjustments) Reference: GA Code § 48-7-27 (Computation of Georgia Taxable Net Income)
No nexus - no state adjustments calculated.

decision_table.name: Calculate_GA_State_Tax
decision_table.description: Calculate Georgia state corporate income tax. Applies 5.75% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to owe tax

rule.policy:
Georgia state corporate income tax calculation:
1. Federal taxable income: [Form 1120 line 28] 2. Apportioned to Georgia: × [Apportionment %] 3. State additions: + [Additions] 4. State subtractions: - [Subtractions] 5. Georgia taxable income: = [Result] 6. Georgia tax rate: × 5.75% 7. Georgia income tax: = [Tax before credits] 8. Georgia credits: - [Credits] 9. Georgia tax liability: = [Final tax]
Reference: GA Form 600 (Corporation Tax Return) Instructions Reference: GA Code § 48-7-21 (Tax rate: 5.75%) Reference: GA Code § 48-7-27 (Taxable net income computation)
No Georgia nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded.
No Georgia taxable income - no tax liability. Georgia NOL rules may apply for future carryforward (not implemented).
